Led by coaches Gabby and Paula, this routine focuses on engaging your core muscles without getting on the floor. You'll perform a series of targeted exercises, including standing crunches, criss-cross crunches, hip hinges, side bends, and side leg lifts. This fat-blasting workout is designed to build stability, improve balance, and tone your midsection through controlled movements. Perfect for all fitness levels.

summary:
## Standing Belly Fat Workout Overview
This is a no-equipment, standing workout designed to **target belly fat** and **strengthen the core**. The routine consists of five exercises performed for 30 seconds each, completed for a total of three sets (one instructional set and two full workout sets).

## Core Exercises & Form Cues
Proper form is crucial for engaging the correct muscles and preventing injury.

### 1. Standing Crunch
- Bring your knee up towards your chest while crunching your upper body down.
- Focus on using your **core muscles** to lift your knee.
- Return to a full standing position between each crunch to complete the movement.
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Avoid pulling on your head or neck. Place your hands lightly behind your ears or just near your head without touching.

### 2. Criss-Cross Crunch
- Bring your opposite knee to your opposite elbow in a twisting motion.
- Keep your **chest up and proud**; initiate the movement from your core.
- The goal is to bring your knee up to your elbow, not to slouch your elbow down to your knee.

### 3. Hip Hinge
- Push your hips straight back, keeping a slight bend in your knees.
- Maintain a **straight back** and a **tight core** throughout the movement.
- Squeeze your **hamstrings and glutes** to return to a standing position.

### 4. Side Bend
- Bend from side to side, feeling a crunch in one oblique and a stretch in the other.
- Keep your back straight and your shoulders down and relaxed.
- Variations include arms down by your sides, behind your head, or overhead.

### 5. Side Leg Lift
- Lift one leg out to the side in a controlled motion, keeping the leg strong and the foot flexed.
- The routine alternates legs on each rep to challenge **core stability and balance**.
- Engage your core to prevent wobbling. Squeeze your glutes as you lift.
> [!TIP]
> If you feel off-balance, hold onto a sturdy chair or wall for support.

## Workout Structure
- **Instructional First Set**: The coaches first demonstrate each of the 5 exercises, providing detailed form cues and modifications.
- **Two Full Sets**: After the tutorial, you will perform two more full sets of all five exercises back-to-back with minimal rest.
